speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: Our latest monitoring reports confirm that migratory birds are increasingly avoiding their traditional resting areas near the wetland.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: The most concerning case is the red knot, a critically endangered species protected under the Bonn Convention.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: If current trends continue, bird collisions and habitat disturbance may significantly damage local populations.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Arcadia has obligations under both the Ramsar Convention and the Bonn Convention.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: International guidance encourages governments to take precautionary measures when developing wind energy projects near important migratory routes.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The project supports SDGs 7 and 13 by producing renewable energy and reducing emissions, but it may simultaneously undermine SDG 15 if adequate protections are not implemented.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: We should consider mitigation measures before construction proceeds any further.
